scripts.name: Cross-Sell Intro (introduces Cortney)
scripts.sentBy: Kelly/Shara from bandanas@ (cc team@); Cortney sends her share as ^xsellc from team@
scripts.subject: a thought on your [PROJECT NAME] run
scripts.body:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Your [PRODUCT] came out great. Quick thought while it's fresh: bandanas are how most people meet us, but if you can put a logo on it, we've probably made it. Shirts, hats, custom promo, all of it.

My teammate Cortney runs that side of the shop and she's copied here. If anything catches your eye or you've got something coming up, just reply and she'll take care of you.

No pressure at all. Either way, glad we got to make these for you.

scripts.name: NewCust_Check4mo_Ban
scripts.subject: the [Project Name] run, and what's next for you?
scripts.body:
Hi [first name],
It's been a few months since your [Project Name] run went out. How did they go over?
And whatever's next for you, we'd love to be part of it. Bandanas are how most people meet us, but we do apparel and branded merch too, so there's more we can do whenever you're ready.
No pressure at all. Just glad we got to make these for you.

scripts.name: Reorder_Ban
scripts.subject: the [Project Name] run, same as last year or switch it up?
scripts.body:
Hi [first name],
Your [Project Name] project from last [Month of last order] is coming up on a year, and I wanted to get ahead of your next one so it's handled before you need it.
I've still got everything from that run on file, so if something's on the horizon I can have it lined up with priority turnaround. And if you're planning anything past bandanas, we do apparel and branded merch too, so I can get ahead of that for you the same way.
When does the next one usually land for you?
No rush at all. Just point me at the timing and I'll plan around it.

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Response
scripts.body:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Cortney here, I run the apparel and promo side at Planet Apparel. Shara passed your note over, happy to help.

What's it for, the crew, an event, client gifts? Tell me what you're picturing and I'll put real numbers together. We've already got your [PROJECT NAME] art on file, so setup is the easy part.

No commitment. If the numbers look right, we'll go from there.
